title: Minogan underwriting hint (UW) v0
description: Advisory underwriting hint derived deterministically from a Mesh score. Minogan is not an insurer and binds nothing; outcome is a recommendation to a human underwriter. No prompts/completions; metadata and trace ids only.

uw_score.description: Integer 0-100, higher = riskier. v0: equals ScorerOutput.score (no separate UW model).

tier.description: Band of uw_score. v0 bands (uncalibrated): T1 <40, T2 40-64, T3 65-84, T4 >=85.

outcome.description: Recommendation only. v0 rule in uw_v0.md section 3.

conditions.description: Terms an underwriter could attach (bind-with-terms). Empty for bind.

exclusions.description: Behaviour classes suggested for exclusion from cover (e.g. unapproved payment writes).

memory_from.description: epoch ms of the oldest AgentMemory record used for long-horizon drift/recurrence (null if none).

confidence.description: 0-1, evidence-volume confidence (deterministic, see uw_v0.md section 4). Not a calibrated probability.
